SSA Program Operations Manual System (POMS) - DI 24550.002 - Body-Mass-Index-for-Age Tables (Age 2 to the Attainment of Age 18)
Effective Dates: 10/06/2023 - Present | TN 2 (10-23)
Source: https://secure.ssa.gov/apps10/poms.nsf/lnx/0424550002 (fetched 2026-10-04)

D. BMI-for-age - third percentile - females - age 2 to the attainment of age 18
Use the table below for females from age 2 to the attainment of age 18. If the child
has not attained age 2, use weight-for-length to determine if the listing criteria
are met (see Weight-for-Length Tables DI 24550.001).
